prompt_text: I need new tires installed in Pleasanton. Which specific tire shops should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I make specific recommendations: do you mean Pleasanton, California? Also tell me the vehicle (make/model/year) or your tire size and any preferences (budget, performance, run‑flat, same-day install, Costco member, need alignment, etc.). 

If you confirm, I’ll give 5–7 specific shops in Pleasanton with phone numbers and why each is a good call. 

Meanwhile, here’s what to consider and who to call depending on your priorities:

- If you want the widest selection and competitive pricing: call Discount Tire (big national chain). They stock many brands, offer fast installs and good balancing/mounting service.
- If you’re a Costco member and want low prices + road‑hazard warranty: call the Costco Tire Center at the nearest Costco (they often have very competitive tire packages but require a membership).
- If you want dealership/OEM fitment or have a warranty issue: call your vehicle’s local dealer (best for OEM‑recommended tires and TPMS/programming).
- If you prefer personalized service and possibly better labor rates: call reputable local independent shops in Pleasanton (they often handle alignments, balancing, and small repairs well).
- If you need convenience (mobile install at your home/work): look for mobile tire installers in the area and call them for on‑site mounting and balancing.

What I’ll include once you confirm Pleasanton + vehicle/tire size:
- 5–7 specific shops (chains + local shops + mobile option)
- Phone numbers and addresses
- Why to call each (selection, price, warranty, convenience)
- Exact questions to ask when you call (price per tire mounted, alignment cost, TPMS fees, wait time, road‑hazard coverage)

Tell me the Pleasanton you mean and your vehicle/tire preferences and I’ll pull the exact shops and contact info.
